questions.stem: During a rural health camp screening in India, a 6-year-old boy is evaluated for developmental delay and unusual skeletal features. His parents report that he has a history of frequent eye and vision issues. A genetic enzymatic defect is suspected. Which condition is associated with a defect in the enzyme cystathionine synthase?

questions.stem: A 25-year-old patient presents with a genetic anomaly affecting the activity of disaccharidases produced by the intestinal epithelial cells. These enzymes are responsible for the digestion of various disaccharides into monosaccharides, which can then be absorbed into the bloodstream. After consuming a meal consisting of milk and oatmeal, both of which contain disaccharides, which of the following would you expect to find in higher levels in this patient compared to a healthy individual?

These enzymes are responsible for the digestion of various disaccharides into monosaccharides, which can then be absorbed into the bloodstream. options.label: A
options.text: Galactose and fructose in the blood.

options.label: C
options.text: Maltose, sucrose, and lactose in the stool

questions.stem: A young woman with laboratory picture of normocytic anaemia and jaundice with splenomegaly was diagnosed to have RBC pyruvate kinase deficiency after a PBS showed spiculated cells. Due to the abnormal function of pyruvate kinase, less pyruvate is formed and the intermediates above pyruvate in the glycolytic pathway get accumulated. Which of the following products is not formed in appropriate amounts in the RBC due to the deficiency of pyruvate?

questions.stem: In a neonatal intensive care unit at a research-focused hospital in India, a preterm newborn is admitted with signs of respiratory distress. The baby's mother had a complicated pregnancy, which led to early labor. The neonatologist considers the biochemical aspects that could be contributing to the baby's condition, specifically focusing on the surfactant composition in the baby’s lungs. A deficiency in one of the surfactant components is suspected. Which lipid component could be deficient in this preterm newborn, contributing to respiratory distress?
